summary: Proposes the Address plus Port approach to the IPv4 address shortage, in which several hosts share one IPv4 address by each being given a distinct range of port numbers. This avoids giving every host a unique global IPv4 address. It is Experimental.

eli5.summary: One building address can serve many people if each gets their own mailbox number. A+P gives each customer one shared address plus a private range of port numbers.
